summary.prose: Building this story makes tracker.push/sync/post fully kind-aware for ISSUE-anchored work items across six layers — head resolution, contexts/prompts, persistence, chain, the atomic pending-create claim with fencing, and doc linkage — proven by unit (prompt-text, head-rule), integration (finalize, chain, claim races/crash/recovery, authority boundary), and smoke (typecheck + baseline-diff) tests.
